topic: carousel strategy as a swipe funnel
audience: creators, consultants, agencies and entrepreneurs who publish educational carousels
narrative_shape: bold system promise -> numbered rules -> strategic reframe -> comment keyword CTA
slide_rhythm: cover with collage and proof cue; one rule per slide; final reframe; direct keyword CTA
visual_system: warm editorial background, oversized black sans headlines, one mustard rounded highlight per slide, strong left alignment, large whitespace, minimal decoration, cover collage with tilted rounded screenshots and fake social metrics bar
trust_signals: caption expands the strategy instead of repeating the slides
comment keyword creates a clear next step
cta_style: comment keyword for deeper system or resource

design_details.typography: heavy sans for rule labels and main claims, elegant serif only on the cover hero word
design_details.spacing: large top whitespace and generous line breaks so each slide reads fast
design_details.layout: slides 2-7 use a consistent top-left rule badge, headline below, then short body blocks
design_details.accent: mustard pill behind rule number or CTA word; use ONIA green only as the equivalent accent
design_details.cover: large provocative headline plus three overlapping mini post examples and an engagement-style bar
design_details.final_slide: minimal centered CTA with one highlighted keyword

slide_pattern.pattern: provocative system promise plus visual proof collage
short claim about the cover's job, then three micro-principles
explain why slide 2 matters and leave tension open
one strong idea that can stand alone as a screenshot
AI helps structure; human judgment decides
design rules as conversion rules, not decoration

slide_pattern.job: make caption part of the system
slide_pattern.pattern: caption deepens, contextualizes and routes people to DM/comment
boxed statement that turns content into brand, authority and sales system
short centered CTA with one highlighted keyword

caption_strategy: Caption should work as the second post, not filler.
It should explain the carousel thesis, add context and invite action.
Use a comment keyword when the next step is a resource, audit or system.
Do not repeat every slide; add the reason behind the slides.
onia_adaptation: Use this as the model for ONIA educational carousels: 'Roba mi sistema para no perder leads', '6 reglas para que una clinica no pierda pacientes por WhatsApp', or 'El sistema simple para responder, filtrar y cerrar clientes'. Keep one job per slide, one strong idea per slide, and a final CTA such as comenta AUDITORIA or escribe SISTEMA.
onia_carousel_prompts: 6 reglas para que tu WhatsApp deje de perder ventas
Roba mi sistema para organizar leads de Instagram
El embudo invisible que una clinica dental necesita antes de comprar mas publicidad
Tu negocio no necesita mas mensajes; necesita seguimiento
Como saber si tu empresa ya esta lista para automatizar ventas
do_not_copy: same mustard color as a brand identity
same CTA keyword unless it fits the ONIA offer
notes: High-value reference for ONIA carousels because it treats carousel production as a conversion system. Use the structure and rhythm only; produce original ONIA copy, visuals and examples.
